fields.title: Light and thermal protection
fields.finding: Added Al opacity and inherited white/attachment package are not verified OD4 or actual optical/thermal properties for new laminates.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure spectral transmission, aged absorptivity/emissivity and adhesion of the complete package.

claim: Added Al opacity and inherited white/attachment package are not verified OD4 or actual optical/thermal properties for new laminates. | Light and thermal protection
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
